sourceActivityMap.key: Parallel lines with transversal: corresponding acute=63°, alternate interior acute=63°, adjacent obtuse=117° because 63+117=180.

ℓ:y=0,m:y=3,t:y=x intersect P(0,0),Q(3,3); midpoint M(1.5,1.5). Half-turn about M swaps horizontal lines and maps t to itself, carrying 45° alternate angles. Nonparallel n:y=0.5x+3 meets t at (6,6), angle difference arctan1-arctan0.5 ≈18.43495°, not45°.
An acute63° angle has alternate interior63° only under parallel-line condition and adjacent117° from supplementary angle sum.
